name: CommonJS to ES Modules Migration Pack
trustedExecutionNote: Packs execute shell commands (perStepTypecheckCmd, checkpointTestCmd, snapshots). Only load trusted packs.
knownLimitations: Requires Node >= 22.12.0 for synchronous `require(esm)` so un-migrated CommonJS callers can load migrated ES modules.
Shimmed/interop modules must not use Top-Level Await (TLA).
Shimmed/interop modules must not use dynamic or conditional exports.
Do not reassign `module.exports` after converting to ESM; export shape must be preserved via static `export` declarations.

packageDetectors.description: Confirms the target is a Node project without an explicit ESM `type` field (ambiguous .js files).

detectionRules.description: Assignment to a named property on exports (exports.foo = ...)

agentGuidance.MIGRATE: Convert this module to ES Modules: replace `require(...)` with `import ...`, and `module.exports` / `exports.x` with `export` declarations. Preserve every exported name exactly. Replace `__dirname` with `fileURLToPath(new URL('.', import.meta.url))` and `__filename` with `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` (import them from `node:url`). Do NOT add any `// @bkb-shim` comments.
agentGuidance.SHIM: This module has un-migrated CommonJS callers. Emit PURE ESM syntax (no dual `require`/`module.exports`). Preserve CommonJS export shape so `require()` keeps working on Node >= 22.12: a callable/default `module.exports = X` becomes `export default X` plus `export { X as "module.exports" }`; named exports (`exports.a`, `module.exports.a`) become `export const a = ...` or `export { a }`. Tag exactly one line with `// @bkb-shim: esm-runtime-interop`. Never use Top-Level Await, dynamic/conditional exports, or reassign `module.exports`.
agentGuidance.DE_SHIM: All callers of this module are now ESM (`pendingCallersCount == 0`). Remove the `// @bkb-shim: esm-runtime-interop` comment line. Keep the pure ESM exports unchanged.
